description.p: With CtrlrX, control any MIDI enabled hardware: synthesizers, drum machines, effects, and samplers. Create custom user interfaces for your favorite MIDI devices, and host your device as VST or AU plugins in your favorite DAW, or run it as standalone software.
CtrlrX is based on the JUCE audio framework by PACE Anti-Piracy Inc. Audio Unit is a trademark of Apple Computer Inc. VST is a trademark of Steinberg Media Technologies GmbH.
